title: Dart
label: Dart
desc: Client-optimized language with sound null safety and ahead-of-time compilation.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the SDK, scaffold a console package, and build a native binary

snippets.code:
# Print the version of the SDK that is on the PATH
dart --version

# Scaffold a console package with pubspec.yaml and analysis_options.yaml
dart create -t console clock
cd clock

# Download the packages declared in pubspec.yaml
dart pub get

# Run the entry point in bin/clock.dart
dart run

# Compile a standalone executable for this machine
dart compile exe bin/clock.dart -o clock

name: clock
description: Prints the time in a few zones
publish_to: none
environment:
  sdk: ^3.9.0

dependencies:
  http: ^1.5.0

dev_dependencies:
  lints: ^6.0.0
  test: ^1.26.0
